originalTitle: Wall Street futures muted as Nvidia earnings loom amid AI jitters
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Monday evening after Wall Street fell sharply, with Nvidia dragging the technology sector lower ahead of its quarterly results, while investors also eyed details surrounding Anthropic's potential initial public offering.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Monday evening after Wall Street fell sharply, with Nvidia dragging the technology sector lower ahead of its quarterly results, while investors also eyed details surrounding Anthropic's potential initial public offering.

S&P 500 Futures inched 0.1% higher to 7,448.0 points, while Nasdaq 100 Futures gained 0.2% to 27,330.75 points by 19:27 ET (00:27 GMT). Dow Jones Futures traded flat at 51,652.0 points.

In the regular session, the S&P 500 fell 1.9%, marking its third consecutive decline. The NASDAQ Composite dropped 2.5%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 1.4%.

Nvidia shares tumbled 4.1%, extending their November losses to nearly 24% and adding to concerns about the chipmaker's leadership transition following Jensen Huang's departure as chief executive last week.

Reports of a possible campaign by prominent Silicon Valley executives to bring Huang back had added to uncertainty, although questions remained over the company's management and future direction.

The company's quarterly results, due on Tuesday, will be a major test of investor confidence. Analysts expect fiscal third-quarter earnings to grow about 90% year over year on revenue of roughly $109 billion, according to LSEG estimates.

Investors will be looking for reassurance that demand for artificial intelligence chips remains strong and that the company's growth outlook can withstand the leadership upheaval.

The weakness extended across the semiconductor industry. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 5.3%, with Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) and Micron (NASDAQ:MU) among the biggest losers, while Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD), Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) and data-centre infrastructure companies also came under pressure.

Fresh U.S. restrictions aimed at preventing Chinese artificial intelligence companies from accessing advanced chips through overseas data centres added another layer of uncertainty for the sector.

Investors were also preparing for Anthropic's highly anticipated stock market debut later this week. The Claude chatbot developer is targeting a valuation of as much as $1.4 trillion and could raise up to $64.4 billion in its offering, potentially making it one of the largest public listings on record.

The listing is expected to provide a fresh gauge of investor appetite for artificial intelligence companies.

Beyond technology, investors were monitoring monetary policy after stronger-than-expected U.S. inflation data last week reinforced expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening. Markets were fully pricing in a December rate hike, while investors awaited minutes from the Fed's October meeting on Wednesday for clues about divisions among policymakers.

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's scheduled remarks and a series of economic releases, including retail sales, will also be watched for signals on the interest-rate outlook and the resilience of the U.S. economy.

chineseTitle: 由于 AI 领域的不安，英伟达财报临近，华尔街期货价格下跌
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周一晚间，华尔街大幅下跌后，美国股指期货几乎没有变化，英伟达在公布季度业绩前拖累科技股走低，而投资者也关注有关 Anthropic 潜在首次公开募股的细节。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周一晚间，华尔街大幅下跌后，美国股指期货几乎没有变化，英伟达在公布季度业绩前拖累科技股走低，而投资者也关注有关 Anthropic 潜在首次公开募股的细节。

截至美国东部时间 19:27（格林威治标准时间 00:27），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.1%，至 7,448.0 点，纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.2%，至 27,330.75 点。道琼斯期货持平于 51,652.0 点。

常规交易时段，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.9%，连续第三次下跌。纳斯达克综合指数下跌 2.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 1.4%。

英伟达股价下跌 4.1%，将 11 月份的跌幅扩大至近 24%，并加剧了人们对黄仁勋上周辞去首席执行官职务后该芯片制造商领导层换届的担忧。

尽管对公司管理和未来方向的疑问仍然存在，但有报道称硅谷知名高管可能会采取行动让黄回归，这增加了不确定性。

该公司将于周二公布的季度业绩将是对投资者信心的重大考验。据 LSEG 估计，分析师预计第三财季盈利将同比增长约 90%，营收约为 1090 亿美元。

投资者将寻求对人工智能芯片的需求依然强劲以及该公司的增长前景能够承受领导层剧变的保证。

整个半导体行业都处于疲软状态。费城半导体指数下跌 5.3%，其中英特尔 (NASDAQ:INTC) 和美光 (NASDAQ:MU) 跌幅最大，而 Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD)、Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) 和数据中心基础设施公司也面临压力。

美国旨在阻止中国人工智能公司通过海外数据中心获取先进芯片的新限制给该行业增添了另一层不确定性。

投资者也在为 Anthropic 本周晚些时候备受期待的股市首次亮相做准备。 Claude 聊天机器人开发商的目标估值高达 1.4 万亿美元，并可能通过其发行筹集至多 644 亿美元，这可能使其成为有记录以来最大的公开上市之一。

此次上市预计将为投资者对人工智能公司的兴趣提供新的衡量标准。

除科​​技股外，上周强于预期的美国通胀数据强化了美联储进一步收紧政策的预期，投资者也在密切关注货币政策。市场已充分消化 12 月加息的影响，而投资者则等待周三美联储 10 月会议纪要，以寻找政策制定者分歧的线索。

美联储主席凯文·沃什的预定讲话和包括零售销售在内的一系列经济数据也将受到关注，以获取有关利率前景和美国经济弹性的信号。
